attributes.proposal_description:
[GovernanceSpace.com](https://www.governancespace.com) provides a transparency portal for __Decentralized Governance__.

We offer interactive dashboards, proposal tracking, voting and treasury management.

Enables the creation of customized spaces for any entity to manage its onchain governance.

Intuitive and accessible interface, making blockchain adoption seamless.

__Purpose: Revolutionizing Decentralized Governance with Transparency and Accountability__

Our purpose is to empower communities, DAOs, and institutions to govern with full transparency and participation, eliminating technological barriers and promoting traceable decisions on the blockchain.

__Go to Market:__

- __Partnerships__: Collaborate with blockchain projects and DAOs.

- __Community Building__: Engage users through interactive events and forums.

- __Open Source__: Community contributions for platform development.

__Business Model:__

- Open-source platform for community use. Integration with paid services for auditing and consulting.

- Whitelabel licensing for businesses and organizations to adopt decentralized governance.

- Premium plans with advanced features and specialized technical support.
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
__Roadmap:__

- __Q1 - Platform Development:__ Focus on building the core features of the Governance Space platform, including proposal tracking and voting mechanisms.

- __Q2 - Community Engagement:__ Launch community initiatives to increase user interaction and gather feedback for platform improvements.

- __Q3 - Multi-Chain Integration:__ Expand platform capabilities to support multiple blockchains, enhancing accessibility and user engagement.

- __Q4 - Strategic Partnerships:__ Establish partnerships with key blockchain projects and DAOs to expand our reach and influence.
attributes.resourcing_duration_estimates:
Team size: 
- We currently have a team of 5 additional collaborators working together with our core project team. We were able to distribute and organize tasks and sprints within our development roadmap. And we also have some technical professionals waiting to be hired according to the increase in projects.

Duration: 
- The platform will be delivered in 6 months, with an additional 6 months of platform support. Totaling __12 months__, following a milestone-based execution model.
- After the project is completed, the cost of maintenance and inclusion of new features will be simplified and reduced.

Development:
- Duration: 6 months (structured across 6 milestones).

attributes.problem_statement:
- __Inefficiency__ - Current governance systems are costly, lacking transparency and accountability, leading to financial inefficiencies.

- __User Engagement__ - Limited user interaction and engagement in governance processes hinder effective decision-making.

- __Complexity__ - Existing systems are complex, making it difficult for entities to implement transparent governance.
attributes.proposal_benefit:
__Why Now:__

- Blockchain and DAOs adoption is growing exponentially but lacks user-friendly solutions.

- The increasing adoption of onchain governance models highlights the urgency for efficient tools.

- Emerging regulations reinforce the need for transparency in decentralized governance.

- Projects and organizations seek reliable solutions to manage their communities and collective decisions.

__Market Size:__

- The decentralized governance market is projected to grow exponentially in the coming years.

- Expansion of DAO adoption across some sectors, including finance, technology and public institutions.

- Growing demand for transparency and traceability solutions in fund management and decision-making.

- Opportunity to become the global standard for onchain governance, offering a reliable and scalable solution.
attributes.supplementary_endorsement:
Project KPIs: We launched the platform just over a month ago with 100% of the traffic generated organically. 
- 8,300 views on the site
- 1,639 active users
- 2m 27s average engagement time per active user

On the platform, we have made available information on over:
- 1,224 DReps profile
- 2,220 Votes
- 12 Governance Actions
- 39 Proposals
- 135 Budget proposals

__TOP 10 Countries__ with the most access to the platform: 
1. United States
2. United Kingdom
3. Brazil
4. Germany
5. Japan
6. Vietnam
7. India
8. Netherlands
9. Argentina
10. Norway

attributes.proposal_description:
[GovernanceSpace.com](https://www.governancespace.com) provides a transparency portal for decentralized governance.

We offer interactive dashboards, proposal tracking, voting and treasury management.

Enables the creation of customized spaces for any entity to manage its onchain governance.

Intuitive and accessible interface, making blockchain adoption seamless.

__Purpose: Revolutionizing Decentralized Governance with Transparency and Accountability__

Our purpose is to empower communities, DAOs, and institutions to govern with full transparency and participation, eliminating technological barriers and promoting traceable decisions on the blockchain.

__Go to Market:__

- __Partnerships__: Collaborate with blockchain projects and DAOs.

- __Community Building__: Engage users through interactive events and forums.

- __Open Source__: Community contributions for platform development.

__Business Model:__

- Open-source platform for community use. Integration with paid services for auditing and consulting.

- Whitelabel licensing for businesses and organizations to adopt decentralized governance.

- Premium plans with advanced features and specialized technical support.
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
Roadmap:

- __Q1 - Platform Development:__ Focus on building the core features of the Governance Space platform, including proposal tracking and voting mechanisms.

- __Q2 - Community Engagement:__ Launch community initiatives to increase user interaction and gather feedback for platform improvements.

- __Q3 - Multi-Chain Integration:__ Expand platform capabilities to support multiple blockchains, enhancing accessibility and user engagement.

- __Q4 - Strategic Partnerships:__ Establish partnerships with key blockchain projects and DAOs to expand our reach and influence.

- The platform will be delivered in 6 months, with an additional 6 months of platform support. Totaling __12 months__, following a milestone-based execution model.
- After the project is completed, the cost of maintenance and inclusion of new features will be simplified and reduced.
